title: Build a directory of 25 university student tech communities and Google Developer Student Clubs in Nigeria
description:
Compile a verified directory of 25 active university developer clubs and student tech communities across Nigerian tertiary institutions (e.g., GDSC chapters, university coding societies, campus tech hubs).

For each record:
1. Institution and Campus Chapter Name.
2. Estimated Student Membership and Primary Tracks (Web, Mobile, AI, Cloud).
3. Public Community URL or Social Handle (LinkedIn, X, or public community link).
4. Current Collaboration Stack (e.g. WhatsApp group, Telegram).

Deliver a clean CSV in the attachment with verifiable public links. No private phone numbers or personal emails.
rationale: Identifies grass-roots tech cohorts and university communities where student leads and campus educators look for free-to-use structured learning tools.
